<p>*Publication date: 2016-11-07* Diamond grinding wheels are suitable for processing the following materials: 1) Cutting tools, rotary tools, molds and wear-resistant components made of cemented carbide materials; 2) Sapphire crystal rods and wafer polishing and grinding; 3) Cermet blades. CBN grinding wheels are suitable for processing the following materials: 1) High-speed steel and high-alloy steel cutting tools, tools and molds; 2) High-hardness quenched steel workpieces and machine tool beds; 3) High-hardness high-alloy castings, such as cylinder liners, wear-resistant parts, etc.</p>
